notes.title: Demo Patch 0.2
notes.notes:
We added support for multiple monitor, 
If you have 2 or more monitor, and want to move Cozy Desktop Konbini to another monitor, just press 'Right Arrow' or there's a red button on the far right
Tested work on both Windows and Mac ᕙᓄ(☉ਊ☉)ᓄᕗ
